work_v2_rule.applicability: The v2 claims are requested only by a strict keel.work_chain_pack.v2 export whose profile is work-chain.v2.
work_v2_rule.registry_rule: The evidence pack, every signed Permit semantic binding, and this recipe must pin verifier-claims.v6 by exact digest. Registry identity alone never establishes a claim.
work_v2_rule.population_rule: The signed scope commitment defines the complete root, authority, delegation, child, value, lifecycle, review, provider-fact, Policy, and revocation populations through the declared cutoff.
work_v2_rule.dispatch_rule: Execution authorization requires a supported signed pre-effect Work v2 dispatch boundary and does not establish provider acceptance or completion.
work_v2_rule.value_rule: Customer-economic value is conserved only by the root-wide Work v2 ledger. AI or model compute spend is outside that pool unless separately governed.
work_v2_rule.presentation_rule: The derived summary and Permit-to-X titles are non-authorizing projections and cannot satisfy or override any verification claim.
